images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single isolated item concept image for image-to-3D generation of a fantasy MMORPG inventory tool.
Primary request: Design an original medieval-fantasy stethoscope inspired by the gameplay purpose of NetHack's stethoscope: an adventurer's reusable examination tool. This is ONE practical, modestly crafted tool, not a magical relic.
Scene/backdrop: uniform light warm gray studio background, minimal soft contact shadow, no environment.
Subject: a clearly recognizable binaural stethoscope with exactly two rounded pale horn eartips, two smoothly curved aged-brass ear tubes, a simple narrow brass spring joining the ear tubes, a dark brown leather-sheathed flexible Y-shaped acoustic tube, one continuous long tube forming one broad open U-shaped loop, and exactly one round brass chestpiece attached securely to the free end. The two ear tubes terminate into the two branches of the Y tube; the joined tube runs down and curves up to the single chestpiece. All joints must be visibly physically connected, no loose ends or impossible crossings.
Design: plain warm aged brass with a few engraved concentric rings, dark brown stitched leather covering the hose, ivory-colored polished horn eartips, round shallow chestpiece with a pale warm-gray diaphragm in a brass rim. Slightly chunky readable parts suitable for a game model and small inventory icon. Gently worn, maintained equipment. No writing or symbols on the chestpiece.
Style/medium: polished realistic game-prop concept render, softly stylized broad forms, believable PBR materials, crisp silhouette, restrained surface wear; in keeping with grounded fantasy leather armor, brass fittings, wooden fishing rods and handcrafted tools.
Composition/framing: square image, one entire assembled stethoscope laid out in a clear open loop, near-orthographic three-quarter overhead view with only a small tilt so the thickness of the chestpiece and tube are visible. The eartips are near the top, the loop near the bottom, the chestpiece lies separately within the silhouette toward the upper-right of the loop without touching or obscuring the ear tubes. Entire object fills approximately 80 percent of frame with generous clean border and clearly separated parts. No cropped pieces.
Lighting/mood: diffuse neutral studio light revealing brass, leather and horn equally, mild highlights, no harsh cast shadows.
Constraints: ONE assembled object only, no extra views, no inset panels, no hands or characters, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no accessories, no case, no background props, no glowing effects, no gemstones, no gears, no modern plastic, no bright chrome. Preserve a simple unmistakable stethoscope silhouette and readable physically coherent construction.

images.purpose: Front, rear and detail views of the same item for 3D modeling
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a 3D prop artist's production reference sheet for a fantasy MMORPG stethoscope.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved visual design reference. Preserve its identity, exact materials, components, proportions and simple construction; create a reference sheet of THIS SAME stethoscope, not a redesign.
Primary request: Show the reference stethoscope clearly from useful modeling angles on one polished landscape sheet.
Scene/backdrop: fully opaque, solid warm off-white background covering the complete canvas. No transparency, no checkerboard, no texture, no environment.
Composition/framing: three clearly separated areas with broad white margins: a large full front view of the complete assembled stethoscope, a somewhat smaller full three-quarter rear view of the same entire object showing the reverse of the chestpiece, and a detail column containing a close-up of the chestpiece in side profile and a close-up of one horn eartip and its brass connector. The front and rear views show one device each; the close-ups are explicitly isolated details of that same device. Keep complete silhouettes comfortably within frame. Keep all the flexible tubing in the same open-loop resting shape across full views. Short clean uppercase labels below the corresponding views, and no other text: "FRONT", "REAR 3/4", "CHESTPIECE", "EARPIECE". Small restrained title: "STETHOSCOPE".
Subject invariants: exactly two pale horn eartips; two smooth curved warm aged-brass ear tubes; stitched dark-brown leather sheaths joining at the same solid brass Y connector seen in the reference; one long flexible leather-covered tube forming one broad open loop; exactly one shallow round brass chestpiece on the tube's free end, with a pale warm-gray diaphragm and plain concentric brass rim. Rear of chestpiece is a simple matching shallow brass housing, no new decoration. Preserve every visible material and connection. Do not add the spring that is absent in the reference. No extra tubes, no cut or disconnected tubing in full views, no tube crossings.
Style/medium: clean realistic game-prop concept rendering matching the reference, crisp contour, readable broad shapes, believable brass reflections and leather stitching. Neutral soft studio lighting that reveals surfaces from all views. High-resolution landscape composition.
Avoid: characters, hands, accessories, pouches, gemstones, magic glow, gears, modern plastic, chrome, logos, watermark, decorative borders, UI mockups, lore paragraphs, dimension claims, exploded internal mechanisms, new design variations.

images.purpose: Same concept with separated tubes and chestpiece for reliable Meshy reconstruction
images.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image: the original fantasy stethoscope concept, used as the exact material and component design reference.
Primary request: Create a clean image-to-3D input of this same stethoscope. Rearrange its resting layout so every tube connection is unmistakable and there are absolutely no overlaps, crossings, intersections, or tangencies between separate parts. Preserve its aged brass, dark brown stitched leather sheathing, pale horn eartips, and single round brass chestpiece with a light diaphragm. Do not add or remove components.
Crucial construction: exactly TWO ear tubes ending in TWO pale horn eartips. Each ear tube connects downward into its own brown branch hose. Those two branch hoses merge at exactly ONE brass Y connector near the upper-middle-left. From the bottom of this Y connector exactly ONE longer brown hose descends, curves around a broad smooth U near the bottom of the image, then rises on the far right, ending at exactly ONE round brass chestpiece. The chestpiece must be far to the RIGHT and BELOW the entire ear-tube assembly, surrounded by empty white space. Leave a wide empty gap between the chestpiece and both ear branches, at least the width of the chestpiece itself. Both branch hoses must remain fully visible from their ear tubes to the Y junction. No stub or capped end at the Y. A human should be able to trace each tube with their finger without crossing or losing any segment.
Composition: one complete assembled stethoscope on a pure opaque white background, one single front-facing near-orthographic overhead view, almost flat but with slight visible brass thickness. Binaural ear assembly at upper left, Y junction at middle left, open U loop lower center, chestpiece at middle right well outside the ear assembly. The complete silhouette is comfortably inside a square canvas with 8 percent margins.
Rendering: clean realistic game-prop concept render with broad readable shapes and restrained detail, neutral evenly lit materials, very faint contact shadow only. Preserve the original plain concentric brass rim and leather stitching. No highlights baked into white spots on the leather. No extra ornament.
Avoid: transparent background, text, labels, extra views, exploded parts, hands, accessory props, display stand, disconnected segments, self-intersecting tubes, tubes hidden behind the chestpiece, chestpiece placed inside the ear assembly, extra chestpieces, diagrams or arrows.
